messages:
natalie: monitoring alert: 5 snapshot PUTs to tenant-bucket showed x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256 (SSE-S3) instead of our CMK.

omar: paste one header?

natalie: ```
PUT /snapshots/tenant-99/2026-03-21.snap
x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256
user-agent: vendor-snapshot-uploader/1.2
Authorization: Bearer svc-upload-zzzz
```

rachel: that auth token maps to svc-snapshot-uploader-prod. If KMS calls failed client may have fallen back to SSE-S3.

encops-bot: anomaly: 5 PutObject events without KMS:GenerateDataKey in last 30m for principal arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/svc-snapshot-uploader-prod.

oncall_sam: immediate mitigations: 1) revoke uploader token (done) 2) apply bucket policy to require aws:kms encryption (in progress) 3) start re-encrypt job for affected objects.

infra_jenkins: audit: recent pipeline template added FEATURE_LEGACY_SSE=true in canary. auto-merge by ci-bot.

rachel: root cause likely template flip + uploader allowing silent fallback.

ci-bot: change 1788887700 merged by auto-merge-bot, author infra_jenkins.

natalie: re-encrypt playbook: aws s3 cp -> quarantine originals -> verify checksums. planning 24h retention for quarantined originals.

legal_kim: looped in. hold external notices until sec confirms contractual impact. prepare draft language.

omar: followups: add CI gate to block toggles that enable legacy SSE, change uploader to fail if CMK unset, org SCP to enforce KMS for snapshot buckets, rotate all pipeline bot creds.

encops-bot: incident INC-2026-522 created and attached inventory. status: mitigated -> postmortem scheduled.
